invariants.rule: The office phone line is voice-only
invariants.detail: Never write 'call or text' anywhere on the site. (386) 301-5775 does not accept incoming SMS.
Not '2 minutes'. An earlier version overclaimed this.
Used in footer copy, llms.txt, and layout.js metadata.

invariants.rule: The home header is untinted glass — this is a decision, not a bug
invariants.detail: backdrop-blur-md with a fully transparent background and text-diva-pink-400 links. Three treatments were built and tested on real devices (solid bg-white/95, frosted bg-white/70 + blur, and untinted); the owner chose untinted. Pink-400 on a white section measures 2.65:1, below the WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum. This trade-off is known and accepted. If it must ever pass AA, the lever is a DARKER LINK COLOR (diva-pink-700 measures 6.0:1), not a background tint — the tint is the part that was rejected.

invariants.rule: Marketing pages and home deliberately do not match
invariants.detail: shell/SiteHeader.js uses dark glass (bg-slate-900/90, white text); home uses untinted light glass. Owner confirmed both should stay. Unifying them is a Phase 4 design decision, not a bug fix.

invariants.rule: JSON-LD must be a plain <script> rendered from a server component
invariants.detail: Never next/script. strategy='beforeInteractive' queues the tag through self.__next_s and injects it client-side, so the schema is absent from the served HTML. Google executes JS and usually still sees it; AI/LLM crawlers read raw HTML and see nothing. This bug was live for months.

invariants.rule: Accordion answers stay mounted in the DOM
invariants.detail: Never {isOpen && <answer/>}. Open/closed is a CSS grid-template-rows 0fr/1fr transition on a wrapper with overflow-hidden. Applies to FAQ.js, faq/FAQAccordion.js, service/ServiceFAQ.js. This single change took /faq from 355 to 1,117 crawlable words.

invariants.rule: Page metadata.title must NOT include the brand
invariants.detail: app/layout.js sets template: '%s | Dazzle Divas Cleaning'. Adding the brand in a page's own title produces a doubled suffix. Budget: title <= 70 chars, description <= 160 chars, measured AFTER the template is applied.

invariants.rule: Never hardcode a year in copy
invariants.detail: 'Zero negative cleanliness reviews in {lastYear}' takes lastYear from app/page.js (a server component) with revalidate = 86400. Computing it client-side causes a hydration mismatch; hardcoding it goes stale.

invariants.rule: next/image sizes must describe the RENDERED width
invariants.detail: A full-bleed fill background is sizes='100vw'. The hero declared 33vw and the browser fetched a 640px variant to stretch across the viewport — a 4.5x upscale. Source images are capped at 2560px on the longest side.

invariants.rule: RSC boundary — lucide icons as props
invariants.detail: When a server page passes a lucide-react icon (a forwardRef component) as a prop, the receiving component must stay a server component (no 'use client'), or Next fails with 'Functions cannot be passed directly to Client Components'.

invariants.rule: Every new route updates five places
invariants.detail: app/sitemap.js, public/llms.txt, the relevant home-page array in testSite.js, the dropdown lists in shell/SiteHeader.js (services / cities / resources), and the Footer arrays. Exception: a new guide only needs an entry in app/components/guides/guides.js plus an llms.txt line — the sitemap imports the registry.

invariants.rule: Pricing and billing policy (owner-confirmed 2026-09-28) — publish nothing outside it
invariants.detail: Turnover tiers $100-140 / $140-200 / $200-280 by bedroom count; 4+BR and luxury custom-quoted. Deep cleaning = 2x the standard clean for the home, $200 minimum. PM volume discount up to 15% (10% for 3-5 properties, 15% for 6-15, custom 16+). NO same-day surcharge; emergency requests MAY carry an emergency fee that depends on time of day and current workload, always quoted before dispatch — never state a fixed emergency fee and never write 'no rush fees'. Scheduled turnovers cost the same on weekends and holidays. Priced per job, NEVER hourly. NO cancellation fee (48 hours' notice requested). Payment: Zelle preferred; also cash, check, Venmo, credit card with a 3% CONVENIENCE fee (not 'processing fee'). PayPal is NOT accepted. PM clients invoiced monthly, net-15. Unchanged in Terms and not revisited: $75 no-access trip charge, late fee on balances over 30 days. Residential, eco-friendly and move-in/out are custom-quoted within 24 hours.
Service-area business with the address hidden on GBP (owner decision 2026-09-26). Never add a street address to the schema or copy.
force-static 302 redirects. Keep out of the sitemap and llms.txt; link with a plain <a>, not next/link.

invariants.rule: Stat claims are owner-confirmed as defensible
invariants.detail: 550+ properties cleaned a year, 98% guest satisfaction, 78% industry average, '#1', 15+ cities, ~20% revenue lift. Confirmed 2026-08-21. Any NEW stat needs a source before it ships.

architecture.leadFlow: Form -> POST /api/quote (validate, honeypot, rate limit, log '[LEAD]' as structured JSON, optional LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL) -> then EmailJS notification from the client. The lead is recorded BEFORE delivery is attempted, so a failed send no longer loses it silently. An email failure is tracked as quote_submit_failed but not shown to the visitor as a failure.

gotchas.issue: The Claude Code Browser pane does not composite frames when hidden
gotchas.impact: CSS transitions never advance, so getComputedStyle returns the PRE-transition value forever. This produced two false conclusions that a Tailwind class 'compiled to nothing' when the CSS was correct.
gotchas.workaround: el.style.transition='none'; void el.offsetWidth; then read. Cross-check by grepping .next/static/css/*.css for the escaped selector and by applying the same class to a throwaway element in the same document.

gotchas.issue: window.scrollTo() in the automated browser does not fire scroll events
gotchas.impact: Scroll-dependent React state never updates, making scrolled-state styling look broken.

gotchas.issue: Vercel Analytics scripts do NOT load from /_vercel/ paths
gotchas.impact: Grepping for '_vercel' in script srcs returns nothing and looks like the feature is disabled. It is not.
gotchas.workaround: Vercel serves them under randomized anti-adblock paths. Check for window.va and window.si instead.

gotchas.issue: Browser-cached image variants mask srcset fixes
gotchas.impact: After fixing a sizes attribute, a browser that visited the old site may keep serving the old small variant.

gotchas.issue: Cloudflare sits in front of Vercel and can override site-level files
gotchas.impact: Cloudflare's Managed robots.txt was silently prepending Disallow rules for ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and others, plus Content-Signal: ai-train=no — directly contradicting app/robots.js. Turned off 2026-08-20.
gotchas.workaround: If AI crawlers ever stop appearing, curl the live robots.txt and check for a Cloudflare managed block before touching app/robots.js.

gotchas.impact: Builds can take 3-5 minutes cold. A stale `next start` will hold port 3000 and silently serve an old build, making fixes look like they did not apply.
gotchas.workaround: taskkill //F //IM node.exe before rebuilding, and confirm the CSS hash changed.
